name: @cooklang/cooklang-import
description: Extract recipes from web page HTML (JSON-LD, MicroData, HTML classes). The cooklang-import extractors compiled to WebAssembly; no network access.

scripts.build-wasm: cd .. && CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP=true CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=fat CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS=1 wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir wasm/pkg --out-name cooklang_import -- --no-default-features --features wasm && rm -f wasm/pkg/.gitignore wasm/pkg/package.json wasm/pkg/README.md wasm/pkg/LICENSE && cp LICENSE wasm/LICENSE
